description: This header file declares callback functions and utility functions related to writing data, used in the cURL command-line tool. It provides the declaration for a write callback function and a function to create an output file.

methods.name: tool_write_cb
methods.description: Callback function for CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION used to handle data writing.

methods.name: tool_create_output_file
methods.description: Creates a local output file for writing, returns true if successful.
